prompt:
SUMMARY: hairstyle a short swept-back pompadour with a sculpted wave over one temple; costume silhouette a long coat made of rigid plates from the shoulders to below the knees, open at the front to show the body armor, with an angular collar; design idea The long coat is built from two rigid banks of panels that hinge at the hips and part down the middle like an orbital gate. face original world-specific features; expression proud, poised closed-lip smile.
A full-body character image, vertical 2:3 (1024×1536): Sima Yan of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the founder of Jin who opened its gates at the end of the Three Kingdoms.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face.
Face — her own, recognisably this character, a woman's face with no beard or facial hair: a regal, imperious haughtiness; fair skin; delicate V-line face with a small, soft chin; medium-sized eyes — deep-set eyes, outer eye corners slightly lifted; low heavy brows; broad soft nose; small bow lips; near-black obsidian eyes; a bare, makeup-free face.
Body and hair: voluptuous, generously curved at bust, hips and thighs build; a short swept-back pompadour with a sculpted wave over one temple; bright red hair.
Expression: a proud, poised look with a faint closed-lip smile, subtle and relaxed.
Legend, carried in her design and bearing: imperial splendor and ambition, the first Jin emperor's regalia.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — MECHA
Costume: a female mecha personification built as a command-type mecha — crowned head unit with an antenna crest, cape-like binder wings, heavy chest plating with an emblem core, a flagship back unit. Solid hard-surface plates with visible joints cover her frame except at the openings named under Exposure; any cape or skirt is made of rigid armored plates; her face and hair stay human.
Silhouette: a long coat made of rigid plates from the shoulders to below the knees, open at the front to show the body armor, with an angular collar. This silhouette sets the overall shape of the costume above — keep its materials, ornaments and rank in this shape; the details are free.
Design idea: The long coat is built from two rigid banks of panels that hinge at the hips and part down the middle like an orbital gate.
Colours: deep plum purple, black lacquer, silver and pale gold. Faction frame: navy-blue and black lacquer heavy plating with cold steel-silver edges, angular command fins, a disciplined symmetrical frame, cold blue glow lines.
Signature item: an imperial jade seal, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette — hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour. She holds it at full scale: one whole object, drawn once, held in front of or beside her body; a long weapon keeps one straight, unbroken shaft with a single head or blade.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare upper arms below the pauldrons, which stay seated on top of her shoulders, and bare upper thighs between the hip armor and thigh-high leg plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2190, the Wei Federation in orbit: a navy-black orbital fortress and capital-ship fleet above a cold blue planet, starfields and a distant sun, hard white floodlights on armored hulls.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: She holds the seal in an open left gauntlet, her right gauntlet resting loosely at her side.
Setting detail: Behind her the parallel ribs of a docking portal open onto the blue planet.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: her whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet inside the frame with clear margins, about four-fifths of the image height; camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only — no second character, horse or other creature. No readable text or numbers — emblems are abstract insignia shapes only, never letters or Chinese characters. No logo, watermark, speech bubble or frame border. A far-future setting only — space stations, starships and high-tech structures — with no traditional East-Asian architecture.
Avoid: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
